English: Molecular malaria surveillance using a novel protocol for extraction and analysis of nucleic acids retained on used rapid diagnostic tests

English: The use of malaria rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) as a source for nucleic acids that can be analyzed via nucleic acid amplification techniques has several advantages, including minimal amounts of blood, sample collection, simplified storage and shipping conditions at room temperature.
Luganda: Okukozesa okukebera omusujja gw’ensiri okw’amangu (RDTs) nsibuka ya nucleic acids asobola okwekenneenyezebwa nga bakozesa obukodyo bw’okwongeza nucleic acid kulina ebirungi bingi, omuli omusaayi omutono, okuggyibwako sampolo, entereka ennyangu n’ensaabaza ey’ebbugumu ly’omu nju.
Yoruba: Ìlò àwọn àyẹ̀wò yíyára ìṣètúpalẹ̀ àmì àìsàn ti ibà (RDTs) ní ìpìlẹ̀ orísun fún núkílẹ́kì àwọn ásíìdì tí a lè ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ rẹ̀ nípasẹ̀ ṣíṣe àfikún àwọn iye núkílẹ́kì ásíìdì tí ó sì ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àǹfàní, pẹ̀lú ìwọ̀n ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí kò pọ̀, àkójọpọ̀ àwọn àpẹẹrẹ, ibi ìpamọ́ tí a ṣe nírọ̀rùn àti àwọn ohun tí wọ́n ma ṣe láti gbe nínú yàrá ìgbóná-gbooru.
Zulu: Ukusetshenziswa kwezivivinyo zokuxilonga ngokushesha zikamalaleveva (RDTs) njengomthombo wama-nucleic acid angahlaziywa kusetshenziswa amasu okunabisa i-nucleic acid kunezinzuzo ezimbalwa, okuhlanganisa amanani amancane egazi, ukuqoqwa kwesampula, isitoreji esenziwe lula kanye nezimo zokuthumela ekamelweni lokushisa.
Hausa: Yin amfani da gwaje-gwajen saurin gano cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro (RDTs) a matsayin tushen asalin asid ɗin nucleic waɗanda za a iya yin nazari ta hanyar dabarun haɓaka acid ɗin nucleic yana da fa’idoji da yawa, gami da ƙaramin adadin jini da ɗaukar samfurin da sauƙin ajiya da yanayin sufurin a yanayin ɗaki.
Northern Sotho: Tšhomišo ya diteko tša phekolo ya letadi ye e tseneletšego (di-RDT) bjalo ka mkothopo wa dinutleleikiesiti e ka sekasekwa ka go diriša mekgwa ya koketšo ya dinyutleleikiesiti tše mmalwa, go akaretšwa ditekano tša fase tša madi, kgoboketšo ya disampole, poloko ye e nolofaditšwego le maemo a thomelo ka thempheretša ya ka phapošing.
Amharic: በኒውክሊክ አሲድ የማጉላት ቴክኒኮች ሊተነተኑ ለሚችሉት የኑክሊክ አሲዶች ምንጭ ለወባ ፈጣን ምርመራ (RDTs) አጠቃቀም አነስተኛ መጠን ያለው ደም፣ የናሙና አሰባሰብ፣ ቀላል የማጠራቀሚያ እና በክፍል መጠነ ሙቀት ውስጥ የማጓጓዝ ሁኔታዎችን ጨምሮ በርካታ ጥቅሞች አሉት።

English: We have systematically developed and extensively evaluated a procedure to extract total nucleic acids from used malaria RDTs.
Luganda: Tukulaakulanyizza era ne twekenneenyeza ddala enseetuka y’okuggya nucleic acid mu RDTs z’omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú ohun tí a là kalẹ̀, a ti ṣe ìgbédìde àti àwọn ìlànà tó gbóòrò láti ṣe ìfàjáde gbogbo iye núkílẹ́kì ásíìdì láti inú ibà RDTs tí wọ́n ti lò.
Zulu: Sithuthukise ngokuhlelekile futhi sahlola kabanzi inqubo yokukhipha ingqikithi yama-nucleic acid kuma-RDT asetshenziswa umalaleveva.
Hausa: Mun ƙirƙiro tsari sosai kuma mun ƙididdige hanya domin fitar da jimillar asid ɗin nucleic daga RDT na zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Re hlamile le go sekaseka kudu tshepedišo ya go ntšha palomoka ya dinyutleleikiesiti go di-RDT tše di šomišitšwego tša letadi.
Amharic: አጠቃላይ ኑክሊክ አሲዶችን በጥቅም ላይ ከዋሉት የወባ RDTs የማውጣት አሰራርን ስልታዊ በሆነ መንገድ አዘጋጅተን በሰፊው ገምግመናል።

English: The co-extraction of DNA and RNA molecules from small volumes of dried blood retained on the RDTs allows detection and quantification of P. falciparum parasites from asymptomatic patients with parasite densities as low as 1 Pf/µL blood using reverse transcription quantitative PCR.
Luganda: Engeri y’okuggya molekyu za DNA ne RNA omulundi ogumu okuva mu musaayi omutono ogukaze ogwasigalidde mu kukola RDTs kisobozesa okukenga n’okubala obuwuka bwa P. falciparum okuva ku balwadde abatalaga bubonero nga balina obuwuka obutono ddala obuweza omusaayi 1 Pf/µL nga bakozesa enkoppa ya DNA/RNA ey’akaddannyuma eya PCR.
Yoruba: Fífà jáde àwọn mólékù DNA àti RNA papọ̀ láti inú ìwọ̀n ẹ̀jẹ̀ tó gbẹ tí a sì tọ́jú pamọ́ sí orí RDTs ń ṣe ìgbàláyè ṣíṣàwárí àti ṣíṣe ìṣirò àwọn kòkòrò párásáìtì P. falcioarm láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n fi ààmì àìsàn hàn pẹ̀lú iye kòkòrò párásáìtì tí ó kéré tó ẹ̀jẹ̀ 1 Pf/µL nípa lílo irinṣẹ́ tó lágbára jùlọ láti fí ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ PCR.
Zulu: Ukukhishwa ngokuhlanganyela kwamangqamuzana e-DNA kanye ne-RNA kusuka kumthamo omncane wegazi elomile eligcinwe kuma-RDT kuvumela ukutholwa kanye nomthamo wezimuncagazi ze-P. falciparum ezigulini ezingenazo izimpawu ezinesisindo sezimuncagazi eziphansi njenge-1 Pf/µL igazi kusetshenziswa i-PCR ehlehlayo yokuloba.
Hausa: Haɗin ɗibo DNA da kuma ƙwayoyin RNA daga ƙananan busassun jini da aka riƙe a kan RDTs yana bayar da damar ganowa da kuma ƙididdige ƙwayoyin cuta na P. falciparum daga marasa lafiya waɗanda ba su nuna alamun cuta ba tare da ƙananan ƙwayoyin cuta masu ƙarancin jini kamar 1 Pf/µL ta amfani da gwajin PCR.
Northern Sotho: Go ntšha mmogo ga dimolekhule tša DNA le tša RNA go tšwa go mothamo o monnyane wa madi ao a omilego ao a šetšego ka gare ga di-RDT a dumelela go hwetša le go hwetša bontši bja dipharasaete tša P. Falciparum go balwetši bao ba hlokago maswao a bolwetši bao ba nago le bontši bja dipharasaete tša ka fase ga tše 1 Pf/µL tša madi ka go šomiša PCR ya pušetšomorago ya bontši.
Amharic: የዲኤንኤ እና አርኤንኤ ሞለኪውሎችን ከትንሽ የደረቀ ደም ከRDTs ላይ ማውጣቱ የP. ፋልሲፓረም ጥገኛ ተውሳኮችን ከ 1 Pf/µL በታች ጥግግት የሆነ ጥገኛ ተውሳክ ካላቸው ታካሚዎች የግልባጭ ቅጂ መጠናዊ PCRን በመጠቀም ለመለየት እና ለመለካት ያስችላል።

English: Based on the extraction protocol we have developed the ENAR (Extraction of Nucleic Acids from RDTs) approach; a complete workflow for large-scale molecular malaria surveillance.
Luganda: Okusinziira ku nseetuka y’okuggya, tukulaakulanyizza enjolekera ya ENAR (Extraction of Nucleic Acids from RDTs); enkola enzijuvu ey’okulondoola omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Lóri ìlànà fífàjáde náà, a ti ṣe ìgbédìde ìlànà ENAR (Ìfàjáde núkílẹ́kì àwọn ásíìdì láti inú RDTs); ìlànà iṣẹ́ tó pé fún òṣùwọ̀n tó tóbi lóri ìṣàkíyèsí àyíká mọ̀lékúlà ibà.
Zulu: Ngokusekelwe kunqubo yokukhipha sithuthukise indlela ye-ENAR (Ukukhishwa kwe-Nucleic Acids kuma-RDTs); ukugeleza komsebenzi okuphelele kokubhekwa kwe-malaria yamangqamuzana amakhulu.
Hausa: Dangane da ƙa’idar ɗebowar mun haɓaka tsarin ENAR (Ɗebo Asid ɗin Nucleic daga RDTs); wani cikakken aikin wurin aikin sa-ido a kan zazzaɓin cizon sauro mai girma.
Northern Sotho: Go eya ka tshepedišo ya go ntšha re hlamile mokgwa wa ENAR (Go ntšha ga Dinyutleleikiesiti go di-RDT); e lego kelo ya mošomo ka botlalo ya tekodišišo ya letadi ka botlalo.
Amharic: በማውጣት ፕሮቶኮል ላይ በመመስረት ለትልቅ የሞለኪውላዊ ወባ ክትትል የተሟላ የስራ ሂደት፤ ENAR (የኑክሊክ አሲዶችን ከ RDTs ማውጣት) አቀራረብን አዘጋጅተናል።

English: Using RDTs collected during a malaria indicator survey we demonstrated that ENAR provides a powerful tool to analyze nucleic acids from thousands of RDTs in a standardized and high-throughput manner.
Luganda: Nga tukozesa RDTs ezaakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu kiseera ky’okubuuza ebibuuzo ku musujja gw’ensiri, twakiraga nti ENAR etuwa ekikozeso ekyamaanyi okwekenneenya nucleic acid okuva mu nkumi n’enkumi za RDTs mu ngeri ezabulijjo n’ez’omutendera ogwawaggulu.
Yoruba: Lílo ohun tí a gbà nínú RDTs lásìkò ìwádìí àmì ìtọ́kasí ibà, a fi hàn pé ENAR pèsè ìrìnṣẹ́ tó lágbára láti ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ núkílẹ́kì àwọn ásíìdì láti inú ẹgbẹ̀rún RDTs tí ò dúró déédé àti ìlànà ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì láti ṣàwárí ògùn.
Zulu: Sisebenzisa ama-RDT aqoqwe phakathi nenhlolovo yenkomba kamalaleveva sibonise ukuthi i-ENAR inikeza ithuluzi elinamandla lokuhlaziya ama-nucleic acid asuka ezinkulungwaneni zama-RDT ngendlela esezingeni eliphezulu nephakeme.
Hausa: Ta yin amfani da RDTs da aka tattara yayin binciken mai nuna alamun zazzaɓin cizon sauro mun nuna cewa ENAR yana byara da kayan aiki mai ƙarfi don nazarin asid ɗin nucleic daga dubunnan RDT a cikin daidaitaccen tsari da kuma hanya mai girma.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša di-RDT tšeo di kgobokeditšwego ka nakong ya dinyakišišo tša go laetša letadi re laeditše gore ENAR e fana ka setlabelo se maatla sa go sekaseka dinyutleleikiesiti go tšwa go diketekete tša di-RDT ka tsela ye e swantšhitšwego le ya tšweletšo ya godingwana.
Amharic: በወባ አመላካች የዳሰሳ ጥናት ወቅት የተሰበሰቡትን RDTs በመጠቀም ENAR ከሺዎች በሚቆጠሩ RDTs ኑክሊክ አሲዶችን ደረጃውን በጠበቀ እና በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ለመተንተን ኃይለኛ ቅልጥፍናን እንደሚሰጥ አሳይተናል።

English: We found several, known and new, non-synonymous single nucleotide polymorphisms in the propeller region of the kelch 13 gene among isolates circulating on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea.
Luganda: Twazuula non-synonymous single nucleotide polymorphisms nnyingi, ezimanyiddwa n’ezitamanyiddwa mu kitundu ky’endagabutonde ekya kelch 13 gene mu bisigalira byokka ebyetooloolera ku Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea.
Yoruba: A rí ọ̀pọ̀ ohun tí a mọ̀ àti ohun tuntun, oríṣiríṣi ọ̀pọ̀ ohun abẹ̀mí núkílíótáìdì tí ó dá wà, tí kò sì jọra ní agbègbè gíìnì kelch 13 láàárín àwọn tó dà nìkan wà ní Bioko Island, ní Equatorial Guinea.
Zulu: Sithole ama-pholimofizimi e-nucleotide eyodwa amaningana, aziwayo futhi amasha, angaziwa endaweni yophephela wofuzo lwe-kelch 13 phakathi kwezindawo ezingazodwa ezizungeza e-Bioko Island, e-Equatorial Guinea.
Hausa: Mun samu da yawa, sanannun da sababbi, marasa daidaituwa guda ɗaya na nucleotide polymorphisms a cikin yanki na ƙwayar gadon kelch 13 a cikin keɓancewar da ke yawo a Tsibirin Bioko, na ƙasar Equatorial Guinea.
Northern Sotho: Re hweditše nucleotide polymorphisms tše mmalwa, tša go tsebega le tše diswa, tša go se swane di tee ka lekaleng la tlhohleletši la kelch 13 gene gareng ga dipharologantši tšeo di phatlalalago ka Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea.
Amharic: በርከት ያሉ፣ የሚታወቁ እና አዲስ፣ ተመሳሳይ ያልሆኑ የነጠላ ኑክሊዮታይድ ቅርፀ-ብዙነት በኬልች 13 ጂን መሽከርከሪያ ክልል ውስጥ በቢዮኮ ደሴት፣ ኢኳቶሪያል ጊኒ ውስጥ እየተዘዋወሩ ካሉ ገለልተኞች መካከል አግኝተናል።

English: Researchers reported more people infected with malaria in Equatorial Guinea and Tanzania when they tested using a method that checks for parasite DNA, as compared to what was reported using the common malaria rapid diagnostic tests kits.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baategeeza nti waaliwo abantu bangiko abaakwatibwa omusujja mu Equatorial Guinea ne Tanzania bwe baakebera nga bakozesa akakodyo akakebera DNA omuli akawuka, bw’ogeraageranya n’ekyo ekyazuulibwa mu kukozesa enkola y’okukebera omusujja n’enkebera ey’amangu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ròyìn ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn tí wọ́n ti ní ibà ní Equatorial Guinea àti ní Tanzania nígbà tí wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò nípa lílo ìlànà kan tí ó ń wo DNA kòkòrò párásáìtì, kí a fiwé ohun tí wọ́n ròyìn nípa lílo àwọn irinṣẹ́ àyẹ̀wò yíyára ìṣètúpalẹ̀ àmì àìsàn ibà lásán.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babike ukuthi baningi abantu abangenwe umalaleveva e-Equatorial Guinea naseTanzania lapho behlola besebenzisa indlela ehlola i-DNA yesimuncagazi, uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okwabikwa kusetshenziswa amakhithi okuhlola axilonga ngokushesha omalaleveva.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun bayar da rahoton ƙarin mutanen da suka kamu da zazzaɓin cizon sauro a Equatorial Guinea da kuma Tanzaniya a lokacin da suka yi gwaji ta hanyar amfani da hanyar da za ta tantance kaskar ƙwayar halittar DNA, idan aka kwatanta da abin da aka ruwaito ta amfani da na’urorin gwajin gaggawa na zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile gore batho ba bantši bao ba fetetšwego ke letadi ka Equatorial Guinea le ka Tanzania ge ba be ba dira diteko ba šomiša mokgwa wo o lekolago DNA ya pharasaete, ge go bapetšwa le seo se begilwego ka go šomiša ditlabelo tše di tlwaelegilego tša diteko tša phekolo ye e tseneletšgo ya letadi.
Amharic: የኢኳቶሪያል ጊኒ እና ታንዛኒያ የጥገኛ ዲኤንኤ ምርመራን በሚያደርጉበት ዘዴ ሲመረመሩ፣ ከተለመዱ ፈጣን የወባ ምርመራ መመርመሪያ ስንቂቶችን በመጠቀም ከተገለጸው ጋር ሲነፃፀር፣ ብዙ ሰዎች በወባ እንደተያዙ ተመራማሪዎች ዘግበዋል።

English: With the new method, scientists could even detect different types of malaria parasites within a population.
Luganda: Mu kukozesa akakodyo akapya, bannassaayansi baali basobola n’okukenga ebika by’obuwuka bw’omusujja gw’ensiri eby’enjawulo ebiri mu bantu.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú ìlànà tuntun yìí, àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì léè ṣàwárí oríṣiríṣi irú àwọn kòkòrò párásáìtì ti ibà láàárín àwọn ènìyàn.
Zulu: Ngale ndlela entsha, ososayensi bakwazi ngisho nokuthola izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimuncagazi zikamalaleveva phakathi kwabantu.
Hausa: Tare da sabuwar hanyar, masana kimiyya za su iya gano nau’o’in cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro daban-daban a cikin al’umma.
Northern Sotho: Ka mokgwa o moswa, bašomi ba tša mahlale ba ka kgona le go hwetša mehuta ye e fapanego ya dipharasaete tša letadi ka gare ga setšhaba.
Amharic: በአዲሱ ዘዴ፣ ሳይንቲስቶች በአንድ ሕዝብ ውስጥ የተለያዩ የወባ ጥገኞችን ሊለዩ ይችላሉ።

English: Malaria continues to kill many people in the world.
Luganda: Omusujja gw’ensiri gweyongerera ddala okutta abantu mu nsi.
Yoruba: Ibà ń tẹ̀síwájú láti pa ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn lágbàáyé.
Zulu: Umalaleveva usaqhubeka ubulala abantu abaningi emhlabeni.
Hausa: Zazzaɓin cizon sauro yana ci gaba da kashe mutane da dama a duniya.
Northern Sotho: Letadi le tšwela pele go bolaya batho ba bantši mo lefaseng.
Amharic: ወባ በአለም ላይ ብዙ ሰዎችን መግደሉን ቀጥሏል።

English: Most doctors use what is called ‘rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs)’ to check for malaria in people.
Luganda: Abasawo abasinga bakozesa kye bayita okukebera okw’amangu (RDT) okukebera omsujja mu bantu.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn dọ́kítà ń lo ohun tí à ń pè ní ‘awọn àyẹ̀wò yíyára ìṣètúpalẹ̀ àmì àìsàn (RDTs)’ láti yẹ ibà wo lára àwọn ènìyàn.
Zulu: Odokotela abaningi basebenzisa lokho okubizwa ngo-‘cwaningo oluxilonga ukudlubulundela (RDTs)’ ukuze bahlole umalaleveva kubantu.
Hausa: Yawancin likitoci suna amfani da abin da ake kira 'Rapid Diagnostic Tests (RDTs)' domin duba cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a cikin mutane.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja dingaka bo šomiša seo re se bitšago ‘diteko tša phekolo ye e tseneletšego (di-RDT)’go lekola letadi go batho.
Amharic: አብዛኛዎቹ ዶክተሮች በሰዎች ላይ የወባ በሽታ መኖሩን ለማረጋገጥ 'ፈጣን የምርመራ ሙከራዎች (RDTs)' የሚባሉትን ይጠቀማሉ።

English: RDTs tests for malaria ‘antigens’ in the blood.
Luganda: RDTs zikebera abasirikale b’omubiri abalwanyisa omusujja mu musaayi.
Yoruba: RDTs má ń ṣe àyẹ̀wò ‘àwọn áńtígẹ́ẹ̀nì’ ibà nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀
Zulu: Ama-RDT ahlola umalaleveva ‘ama-antijini’ egazini.
Hausa: Gwajin RDTs na cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro ‘furotin na musamman’ a cikin jini.
Northern Sotho: Diteko tša RDT tša dipaktheria tša letadi ka mading.
Amharic: RDTs በደም ውስጥ የወባ 'ጸረ እንግዳ አካል'ን ይመረምራሉ።

English: Antigens are special proteins that the body produces when it fights a disease.
Luganda: Abasirikale b’omubiri ziba puloteyini ez’enjawulo omubiri be gufulumya nga gulwanyisa obulwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn áńtígẹ́ẹ̀nì ni àwọn èròjà amáradàgbà tó dá yàtọ̀ tí ẹ̀yà ara má ń pàsè tí ó bá ń bá ààrùn kan jà.
Zulu: Ama-antijini ayizakhamzimba ezikhethekile ezikhiqizwa umzimba lapho ulwa nesifo.
Hausa: Furotin na musamman, furotin ne na musamman da jiki yake samarwa idan yana yaƙi da cuta.
Northern Sotho: Dipaktheria ke diphrotheine tše di kgethegilego tšeo di tšweletšwago ke mmele ge o lwantšha bolwetši.
Amharic: ጸረ እንግዳ አካሎች ሰውነት በሽታን በሚዋጋበት ጊዜ የሚያመርታቸው ልዩ ፕሮቲኖች ናቸው።

English: However, RTDs may not always pick up malaria, especially if patients don’t show any symptoms.
Luganda: Wabula, oluusi RDTs ayinza obutalengera bulungi musujja gwansiri naddala singa abalwadde baba nga tebalina kabonero konna ke balaga.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀-síbẹ̀, RTDs léè má ma mú ibà nígbà gbogb, pàápàá jùlọ tí aláìsàn ò bá fi àmì àìsàn hàn.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, ama-RTD angase angawutholi njalo umalaleveva, ikakhulukazi uma iziguli zingabonisi zimpawu.
Hausa: Duk da haka, RTD ba koyaushe yake gano zazzaɓin cizon sauro ba, musamman idan marasa lafiya ba su nuna alamun ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, di-RTD ka mehla di ka kgona go hwetša letadi, kudukudu ge e le gore balwetši ga ba laetše maswao afe go ba afe.
Amharic: ነገር ግን፣ RTDs ሁልጊዜም የወባ በሽታን ላያገኙ ይችላሉ፣ በተለይ ሕመምተኞች ምንም ምልክቶች ካላሳዩ።

English: Scientists say it is better to check for the parasite DNA instead.
Luganda: Bannassaayansi bagamba nti kisingako waakiri okukebera Obuwuka bw’omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì sọ pé ó dára láti wo DNA kòkòrò párásíátì.
Zulu: Ososayensi bathi kungcono ukuhlola i-DNA yesimuncagazi esikhundleni.
Hausa: Masana kimiyya sun ce yana da kyau a bincika kaskar ƙwayar halittar DNA a maimakon haka.
Northern Sotho: Bašomi ba tša mahlale ba bolela gore go kaone go lekola dipharasete tša DNA sebakeng seo.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶች እንደሚናገሩት በምትኩ ጥገኛ ዲኤንኤ መኖሩን ማረጋገጥ የተሻለ ነው።

English: DNA are small molecules that contain genetic information.
Luganda: DNA buba bumolekyu obubeeramu obubaka obukwata ku ndagabutonde.
Yoruba: DNA ní àwọn mólékù kékèèké tó kó ìròyìn gẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì sínú.
Zulu: I-DNA amangqamuzana amancane aqukethe ulwazi lofuzo.
Hausa: Ƙwayar halittar DNA ƙananan ƙwayoyin halitta ne waɗanda suke ɗauke da bayanan ƙwayoyin gado.
Northern Sotho: DNA ke dimolekhule tše nnyane tšeo di nago le tshedimošo ya ditšini.
Amharic: ዲኤንኤ የዘረመል መረጃን የያዙ ትናንሽ ሞለኪውሎች ናቸው።

English: In this study, the researchers developed and tested a method that checked for malaria parasite DNA when testing for malaria.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baakulaakulanya era ne bagezesa akakodyo ak’okukebera DNA omuli akawuka k’omusujja gw’ensiri mu kiseera ky’okukebera omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ìgbédìde àti àyẹ̀wò ìlànà kan tí ó ń wo DNA kòkòrò párásíìtì ibà nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń ṣàyẹ̀wò ibà.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bathuthukise futhi bahlola indlela eyahlola i-DNA ye-malaria umalaleveva lapho kuhlolwa umalaleveva.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun ƙirƙira da kuma gwada hanyar da za ta bincika kaskar ƙwayar halittar DNA ta zazzaɓin cizon sauro a yayin gwajin zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba hlamile le go leka mokgwa wo o lekotšego DNA ya pharasaete ya letadi ge ba dira diteko tša letadi.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ የወባ በሽታን በሚመረመሩበት ጊዜ የወባ ጥገኛ ዲኤንኤ መኖሩን የሚፈትሽ ዘዴ ሠርተው ሞክረዋል።

English: They used blood samples collected from used RDTs kits that had been used in another study that tested for malaria in Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea in 2018 and Bagamoyo, Tanzania, in 2016 and 2018.
Luganda: Baakozesa sampolo z’omusaayi ogwakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu RDTs ogwali gukozeseddwa mu kunoonyereza okulala okwakebera omusujja gw’ensiri mu Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea mu 2018 ne Bagamoyo, Tanzania, mu 2016 ne 2018.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lo àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ tí wọ́n gbà láti inú àwọn irinṣẹ́ RDTs tí wọ́n ti lò nínú ìwádìí mìíràn tí ó sì ṣàyẹ̀wò ibà ní Bioko island, Equatorial Guinea ní 2018 àti Bagamoyo ní Tanzania ní ọdún 2016 àti ọdún 2018.
Zulu: Basebenzise amasampula egazi aqoqwe kumakhithi e-RDT asetshenzisiwe ayesetshenziswe kolunye ucwaningo olwahlolelwa umalaleveva eBioko Island, Equatorial Guinea ngo-2018 naseBagamoyo, eTanzania, ngo-2016 nango-2018.
Hausa: Sun yi amfani da samfurorin jini da aka tattara daga kayan aikin RDT da aka yi amfani da su a wani binciken da aka yi gwajin cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a Tsibirin Bioko, na ƙasar sEquatorial Guinea a hekarar 2018 da kuma Bagamoyo, ta Tanzaniya, a shekarun 2016 da 2018.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše disampole tša madi tšeo di kgobokeditšwego go ditlabelo tša di-RDT le tšeo di šomišitšwego ka dinyakišišong tše dingwe tšeo di lekotšego letadi ka Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea ka 2018 le ka Bagamoyo, Tanzania, ka 2016 le ka 2018.
Amharic: በባዮኮ ደሴት፣ ኢኳቶሪያል ጊኒ እና ባጋሞዮ፣ ታንዛኒያ፣ በ2016 እና 2018 በተደረገ ሌላ ጥናት ላይ ለወባ ምርመራ ጥቅም ላይ ከዋሉት የ RDTs መመርመሪያ ስንቂቶች የተሰበሰቡ የደም ናሙናዎችን ተጠቅመዋል።

English: They also included Mkuranga district primary school children in Tanzania.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu era baateekamu n’abaana ba pulayimale mu disitulikiti ya Mkuranga mu Tanzania.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣàfikún àwọn ọmọ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ alákọ̀ọ́bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní agbègbè Mkuranga ní Tanzania.
Zulu: Bahlanganisa nezingane zesikole samabanga aphansi esifundeni saseMkuranga eTanzania.
Hausa: Sun kuma haɗa da yaran makarantar firamaren gundumar Mkuranga a Tanzaniya.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile gape ba akaretša Sekolo sa bana sa phoraemari sa selete sa Mkuranga ka Tanzania.
Amharic: በታንዛኒያ የሚገኙ የሙኩራንጋ ወረዳ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ልጆችንም አካተዋል።

English: From these blood sample remains, the researchers extracted and tested for malaria parasite DNA.
Luganda: Okuva mu sampolo z’omusaayi ezo ezaasigalawo, abanoonyereza baggyamu era ne bakebera DNA omuli omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Láti inú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ ẹ̀jẹ̀ tókù, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ìfàjáde àti àyẹ̀wò fún DNA kòkòrò párásáìtì ibà.
Zulu: Kulezi zinsalela zesampula yegazi, abacwaningi bakhipha futhi bahlola i-DNA yesimuncagazi se-malaria.
Hausa: Daga cikin ragowar samfurorin jini, masu binciken sun ciro tare da gwada kaskar ƙwayar halittar DNA na zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo go mašaledi a disampole tša madi, banyakišiši ba ntšhitše le go leka DNA ya dipharasaete tša letadi.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ የደም ናሙና ቅሪቶች፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ የወባ ጥገኛ ዲኤንኤን አውጥተው ምርመራ አድርገዋል።

English: They said that among Tanzanian primary school children who did not show any symptoms of malaria, their method detected malaria parasite DNA in 91% of positive malaria RDTs, and 12% negative malaria RDTs.
Luganda: Baagamba nti mu baana ba pulayimale mu Tanzania abataalina kabonero konna ak’omusujja gw’ensiri, akakodyo kaabwe kaakenga DNA omuli omusujja gw’ensiri mu bitundu 91% ebya RDTs omuli omusujja gw’ensiri, ate n’ebitundu 12% ebya RDTs omutali musujja gwansiri.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé láàárín àwọn ọmọ ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ alákọ̀ọ́bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní Tanzania tí wọn kò fi ààmì àìsàn ibà hàn, ìlànà wọ́n ṣàwárí DNA kòkòrò párásáìtì ibà nínú ìdá 91% ibà RDTs tó jẹ́ òótọ́ àti ìdá 12% ibà RDTs tó jẹ́ irọ́.
Zulu: Bathe phakathi kwezingane zasesikoleni samabanga aphansi eTanzania ezingabonisi zimpawu zikamalaleveva, indlela yabo ithole i-DNA izimuncagazi zikamalaleveva kuma-91% e-RDTs ewumalaleveva, kanye nama-12% e-RDTs engalungile.
Hausa: Sun ce a tsakanin yaran makarantar firamare na Tanzaniya da ba su nuna alamun cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro ba, hanyarsu ta gano ƙwayar halittar DNA ta ƙwayar cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a cikin kashi 91% a cikin gwajin RDTs na masu cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro, da kuma kashi 12% a cikin gwajin RDTs na marasa cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore gareng ga bana ba dikolo tša phoraemari tša Tanzania bao ba bego ba sa laetše maswao afe goba afe a letadi, mokgwa wa bona o hweditše DNA ya dipharasaete tša letadi ka go 91% ya di-RDT tša bao ba nago le letadi, le 12% ya di-RDT tša bao ba nago le letadi.
Amharic: ምንም አይነት የወባ ምልክት ካላሳዩት የታንዛኒያ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ህጻናት፣ የእነሱ ዘዴ የወባ ጥገኛ ዲኤንኤ 91%ቱን አዎንታዊ የወባ RDTs እና 12%ቱ አሉታዊ የወባ RDTs ማግኘታቸውን ተናግረዋል።

English: In Bagamoyo, Tanzania, their method detected malaria parasites in 54% of the total samples, while with RDTs only 12% of the samples were said to be positive for malaria.
Luganda: Mu Bagamoyo, Tanzania, akakodyo kaabwe kaakenga obuwuka bw’omusujja gw’ensiri mu bitundu 54% mu sampolo zonna, ate bwe baakozesa RDTs zaabwe ebitundu 12% byokka ebya sampolo bye byagabmbibwa okusangibwamu omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Ní Bagamoyo, ní Tanzania, ìlànà wọn ṣàwárí àwọn kòkòrò párásáìtì ibà nínú ìdá 54% tó jẹ́ àpapọ̀ àwọn àpẹẹrẹ, pẹ̀lú RDTs nìkan, ìdá 12% àwọn àpẹẹrẹ nàá jẹ́ eyi tó jẹ́ òótọ́ fún ibà
Zulu: E-Bagamoyo, eTanzania, indlela yabo ithole izimuncagazi zikamalaleveva kuma-54% wesamba samasampula, kuyilapho ngama-RDT kuphela amasampula angama-12% okuthiwa anesifo sikamalaleveva.
Hausa: A Bagamoyo, ta ƙasar Tanzaniya, hanyarsu ta gano ƙwayar cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a cikin 54% na jimlar samfurorin, a yayin da RDTs kawai 12% na samfurorin aka ce suna da cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Ka Bagamoyo, Tanzania, mokgwa wa bona o hweditše dipharasaete tša letadi ka go 54% ya palomoka ya disampole, mola e le gore di-RDT fela 12% ya disampole go be go bolelwa gore e na le letadi.
Amharic: በባጋሞዮ፣ ታንዛኒያ፣ ዘዴያቸው ከአጠቃላይ ናሙናዎች ውስጥ 54%ን የወባ ጥገኞችን ያገኘ ሲሆን በ RDTs ናሙናዎች 12%ው ብቻ ወባ ያለባቸው ናቸው ተብሏል።

English: In Equatorial Guinea, the researchers reported malaria parasite DNA in 31% of people (samples) who did not show symptoms of malaria.
Luganda: Mu Equatorial Guinea, abanoonyereza baazuula DNA omuli obuwuka bw’omusujja gw’ensiri mu bitundu 31% mu bantu (sampolo) abataalaga bubonero bwa musujja gwansiri.
Yoruba: Ní Equatorial Guinea, àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ ìròyìn ìdá 31% àwọn ènìyàn tí DNA kòkòrò párásáìtì ibà wà lára wọn (àwọn àpẹẹrẹ) tí kọ̀ fi ààmì àìsàn ibà hàn.
Zulu: E-Equatorial Guinea, abacwaningi babike i-DNA yesimuncagazi ema-31% abantu (amasampula) abangazange babonise izimpawu zikamalaleveva.
Hausa: A Equatorial Guinea, masu binciken sun bayar da rahoton ƙwayar cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a ƙwayar halittar DNA a cikin kashi 31% na mutanen (samfurori) waɗanda ba su nuna alamun cutar ba.
Northern Sotho: Ka Equatorial Guinea, banyakišiši ba begile DNA ya dipharasaete tša letadi ka go 31% ya batho (disampole) bao ba bego ba s alaetše maswao a letadi.
Amharic: በኢኳቶሪያል ጊኒ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ የወባ በሽታ ምልክቶችን ካላሳዩ በ 31% ሰዎች (ናሙናዎች) ውስጥ የወባ ጥገኛ ዲኤንኤን ሪፖርት አድርገዋል።

English: They said they were also able to identify 3 different types of malaria parasites.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti baasobola okukenga ebika by’obuwuka bw’omusujja gw’ensiri eby’enjawulo bya mirundi 3.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ní àwọn léè tọ́ka sí oríṣi 3 irúfẹ́ àwọn kòkòrò párásáìtì ibà.
Zulu: Bathe bakwazile nokuhlonza izinhlobo ezi-3 ezahlukene zezinambuzane zikamalaleveva.
Hausa: Sun ce sun kuma iya gano nau’o’in ƙwayoyin cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro guda 3.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ba be ba kgona go hlatha mehuta bye 3 ye e fapafapanego ya dipharasaete tša letasdi.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም 3 የተለያዩ የወባ ጥገኞችን መለየት መቻላቸውን ተናግረዋል።

English: The researchers said unlike what was found in 1996 and 1998 surveys, they did not find the malaria parasite ‘P. vivax’ in Bioko Island.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ng’oggyeeko ebyo ebyazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza kwa 1996 ne 1998, tebaazuula kawuka ka musujja gwansiri P. vivax’ mu Bioko Island.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé, kò dàbí ohun tí wọ́n rí nínú ìwádìí 1996 àti 1998, wọ́n kò ṣàwárí kòkòrò párásáìtì ibà ‘P. vivax’ ní Bioko Island.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ngokungafani nalokho okwatholakala ocwaningweni lwangowe-1996 nowe-1998, abasitholanga isimuncagazi sikamalaleveva ‘P. vivax’ esiqhingini i-Bioko.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce ba kamar yadda aka gano a cikin binciken shekarun 1996 da 1998 ba, su ba su sami ƙwayar cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro ‘P. vivax' a Tsibirin Bioko ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore go fapana le seo se hweditšwego ka dinyakišišong tša ngwaga wa 1996 le wa 1998, ga se ba hwetša pharasaete ya letadi ye e bitšwago P. vivax’ ka Bioko Island.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በ1996 እና 1998 የዳሰሳ ጥናቶች ከተገኙት በተለየ፣ የወባ ጥገኛ ‘ፒ. ቪቫክስ'ን በቢዮኮ ደሴት አላገኙም።

English: They instead only found ‘P. malariae’ and ‘P. ovale’.
Luganda: Wabula, baazuula ‘P. malariae’ ne ‘P. ovale’ byokka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàwárí ‘P. malariae’ àti ‘P. ovale’ níkan.
Zulu: Kunalokho bathola u-'P. malaleveva’ kanye ‘noP. ovale'.
Hausa: A maimakon haka sun sami kawai ‘P. malariae’ da kuma ‘P. ovale’.
Northern Sotho: Sebakeng seo ba hweditše fela ‘P. malariae’ le ‘P. ovale’.
Amharic: በምትኩ ‘ፒ. ማላሪዬ' እና 'ፒ. ኦቫሌ'ን ብቻ አግኝተዋል።

English: They also said that 1 out of 290 malaria parasites tested was more likely to be resistant to malaria medicine called ‘artemisinin’, meaning that the parasite survives a drug meant to kill it.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti akawuka 1 ku 290 ak’omusujja gw’ensiri akaakebera kaali kalabika okugugubira eddagala ly’omusujja gw’ensiri eriyitibwa artemisinin’, ekitegeeza nti akawuka ako kagugubira eddagala eriruubirira okukatta.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé 1 nínú àwọn 290 kòkòrò párásáìtì ibà tí wọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wò rẹ̀, léè jẹ́ èyí tí kìí fàyègba ògùn ibà tí a pè ní ‘artemisinin’, ní èyí tó túmọ̀ sí pé kòkòrò párásáìtì ye ògùn tó yẹ kó pa á.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi isimuncagazi sikamalaleveva esi-1 kwezingama-290 ezihloliwe kungenzeka ukuthi simelane nomuthi kamalaleveva obizwa nge-‘athemisinini’, okusho ukuthi isimuncagazi siyasinda emuthini okuhloswe usibulale.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce kashi 1 cikin 290 na ƙwayoyin cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro da aka gwada sun fi iya juriya da maganin zazzaɓin cizon sauro mai suna ‘artemisinin’, ma’ana ƙwayar cutar ta tsira daga wani magani da aka samar don kashe ta.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gape gore pharasaete ye 1 go tše 290 tša letadi tšeo di dirilwego diteko go be go na le kgonagalo ya gore e ka palela dihlare tša letadi tšeo di bitšwago ‘artemisinin’, go rago gore pharasaete ye e kgona go phela ya se bolawe ke sehlare seo se diretšwego go e bolaya.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ከተመረመሩት 290 የወባ ጥገኞች መካከል 1ዱ ‘አርቴሜሲኒን’ የተባለውን የወባ መድሀኒት የመቋቋም እድሉ ከፍተኛ ነው፣ ይህም ማለት ጥገኛው ሊገድለው ከታቀደው መድኃኒት ተርፏል ማለት ነው።

English: The researchers said their method worked well because they did not need lots of blood, and that even after storing samples for over 18 months at room temperature (25 oC), they could still detect malaria parasite DNA.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti akakodyo kaabwe kaakola bulungi kubanga baali tebeetaaga musaayi mungi, era nti oluvannyuma lw’okutereka sampolo okumala emyezi 18 mu bbugumu ly’omu nju (25 oC), era baali basobola okukenga DNA omuli obuwuka bw’omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí sọ pé ìlànà àwọn ṣiṣé dáada nítorí pé àwọn ò nílò ẹ̀jẹ̀ tó pọ̀, àti wí pé lẹ́yìn àwọn àpẹẹrẹ náà fún bíi oṣù 18 nínú yàrá ìgbóná-gbooru (25 oC), wọ́n sì tún lè ṣàwárí DNA kòkòrò párásáìtì ibà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi indlela yabo isebenze kahle ngoba babengadingi igazi eliningi, nokuthi ngisho nangemva kokugcina amasampula isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyi-18 endaweni yezinnga lokushisa lasendlini (25 oC), basengakwazi ukubona i-DNA yegciwane likamalaleveva.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce hanyarsu ta yi aiki da kyau domin ba sa buƙatar jini mai yawa, kuma ko da bayan adana samfurorin sama da watanni 18 a ɗakin ɗaki mai yanayi (25 oC), za su iya gano ƙwayar cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a ƙwayar halittar DNA.
Northern Sotho: The resBnayakišiši ba boletše gore mokgwa wa bona o šomile gabotse ka ge ba be ba sa hloke madi a mantši, le gore le ka morago ga go boloka disampole mo nakong ya go feta dikgwedi tše di fetago tše 18 ka thempheretšha ya ka phapošing (25 oC), ba ka kgona go hwetša DNA ya pharasaete ya letadi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ብዙ ደም ስለማያስፈልጋቸው ዘዴያቸው ጥሩ ውጤት ያስገኘ ሲሆን፣ ናሙናዎችን ከ18 ወራት በላይ በክፍል መጠነ ሙቀት (25 °C) ካከማቹ በኋላም የወባ ጥገኛ ዲኤንኤን መለየት እንደሚችሉ ተናግረዋል።

English: This study was done in Tanzania and Equatorial Guinea, by researchers based in Switzerland, Equatorial Guinea and Tanzania.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa mu Tanzania ne Equatorial Guinea, era nga kwakolebwa banoonyereza abakolera mu Switzerland, Equatorial Guinea ne Tanzania.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí yìí ní Tanzania àti Equatorial Guinea, láti ọwọ́ àwọn aṣèwádìí ní Switzerland, Equatorial Guinea àti ní Tanzania.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lwenziwe eTanzania nase-Equatorial Guinea, ngabacwaningi abazinze eSwitzerland, Equatorial Guinea naseTanzania.
Hausa: An yi wannan binciken ne a Tanzaniya da Equatorial Guinea, ta masu bincike da ke Switzerland, Equatorial Guinea da Tanzania.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di dirilwe ka Tanzania le ka Equatorial Guinea, ke banyakišiši bao ba bego ba le ka Switzerland, Equatorial Guinea le ka Tanzania.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት የተካሄደው በታንዛኒያ እና ኢኳቶሪያል ጊኒ ሲሆን መቀመጫቸው በስዊዘርላንድ፣ ኢኳቶሪያል ጊኒ እና ታንዛኒያ በሆኑ ተመራማሪዎች ነው።
